title: Switch-Controlled MUX → LEDs
description: Build a 2-to-1 multiplexer, verify its truth table, then map it to board switches and LEDs.

steps.title: Build 2-to-1 Multiplexer
steps.description: Create a 2-to-1 multiplexer using AND, OR, and NOT gates. Inputs: A, B, SEL. Output: Y.
hints: The formula is: Y = (A AND NOT SEL) OR (B AND SEL)
You'll need 2 AND gates, 1 OR gate, and 1 NOT gate
Label your input nodes A, B, and SEL, and your output node Y

steps.title: Verify Truth Table
steps.description: Test all input combinations and verify the output matches the expected MUX behavior.
hints: When SEL=0, Y should equal A
When SEL=1, Y should equal B

steps.title: Map to Board
steps.description: Map your MUX inputs to board switches (SW0-SW2) and output to LED0.
hints: Map A → SW1, B → SW2, SEL → SW0
Toggle the switches to see LED0 respond

steps.title: Verify Board I/O
steps.description: Test the board mapping by verifying LEDs respond correctly to switch inputs.
